https://aiworldwire.org/articles/deepsee.next: Dekhna hoga ke independent coding tests DeepSeek ke apne benchmark claims ko confirm karte hain ya nahi — aur US order ka scope kitna wasee hai, kya API access aur US-hosted copies bhi is mein aati hain.
https://aiworldwire.org/articles/deepsee.take: Meri take: sasta, khula, tez — aur phir bhi banned. Yehi AI ki nayi haqeeqat hai: model jitna acha hoga, politics utni hi zyada hogi. Pakistani developers ke liye ye model ek gift hai, bas ye yaad rakho ke jo model aaj free hai, kal us ka access kisi order se band bhi ho sakta hai. Apna kaam kisi ek model pe mat bandho.
https://aiworldwire.org/articles/deepsee.what: DeepSeek ne 17 October ko V4.1-Flash-1017 release kiya — MIT licence ke saath open weights, 1-million-token context, aur $0.15 per million input tokens se shuru honay wali pricing. Artificial Analysis index pe score 45 hai, September version ke 39 se upar. Doosri taraf US Homeland Security ka order 19 October ko public hua jo federal civilian agencies ko DeepSeek products hatane ka kehta hai.
https://aiworldwire.org/articles/deepsee.why: Ye do khabrein ek saath parho to AI ki duniya ka split nazar aata hai: ek taraf model sasta aur khula hota ja raha hai, doosri taraf governments usay apne systems se nikaal rahi hain. Developers ke liye price aur access behtar ho raha hai, lekin enterprise aur government deals ke liye DeepSeek ka rasta mushkil hota ja raha hai.

https://tribune.com.pk/story/2636740/psx.next: Aaj Monday ko State Bank ki monetary policy announcement hai — wo market ki direction tay karegi. Agar policy ne bharosa wapas dilaya to recovery ka chance hai, warna girawat jari reh sakti hai. Aur Brent crude pe nazar rakhni hogi.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2636740/psx.take: Meri take: paanch hafte lagatar laal — ye koi coincidence nahi, ye signal hai. Market ko sirf achi khabrein nahi, stability chahiye. Jab duniya mein jang ka dar ho aur andar deficit barh raha ho to investor paisa nikaal leta hai, ye normal hai. Lekin chhote investors ke liye yehi waqt sab se khatarnak hota hai — panic mein bechna. Agar aap long-term investor nahi hain to is waqt market mein hath mat daalo, sirf dekho.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2636740/psx.what: PSX ka benchmark KSE-100 index guzre hafte 2.4% gira — 4,045 points kho kar 162,375 pe band hua. Ye musalsal paanchwa haftawar girawat wala hafta tha, aur index 166,000, 164,000 aur 163,000 ki levels se neeche aa gaya. Wajah: barhti geopolitical tensions, oil prices ka upar jana, aur domestic economic uncertainty. Isi hafte trade deficit 1QFY27 mein 21.1% barh kar $9.33 billion ho gaya.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2636740/psx.why: Stock market sirf ameer logon ka khel nahi — jab index paanch hafte lagatar gire to is ka matlab hai ke investors ko mulk ki direction pe bharosa kam ho raha hai. Oil $114 per barrel se upar aur trade deficit ka barhna dono mil kar yehi kehte hain: bahar ka pressure aur andar ki kamzori ek saath aa gaye hain.

https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/technology/.next: Dekhna hoga ke indemnity ki shartein kitni wasee hain — har use case cover hota hai ya sirf khaas workflows. Agar Adobe isay standard bana de to baqi AI image tools ko bhi yehi karna parega.
https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/technology/.take: Meri take: Adobe ne sahi jagah hath rakha hai — client ko image nahi, sukoon bech raha hai. Lekin indemnity ka matlab ye nahi ke AI image har jagah safe hai; fine print parhna lazmi hai. Pakistani freelancers ke liye lesson: client ko sirf design mat do, us ke legal risk ka jawab bhi do — yehi premium price ki wajah banti hai.
https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/technology/.what: Adobe apni AI graphics ko 'commercially safe' keh kar bech raha hai — aur agar client ko generated visuals ki wajah se legal case ka samna ho to indemnity ka wada bhi kar raha hai. Brands ab AI visuals use karne se pehle copyright aur legal risk ka hisaab laga rahe hain, aur Adobe isi dar ka jawab de raha hai.
https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/technology/.why: AI images ka sab se bara sawal ab quality nahi, legality hai: ye image kis ke kaam se seekh kar bani? Jo company is sawal ka jawab apne paisay se de — indemnity ke zariye — wo corporate clients jeet jayegi. Baqi tools saste ho sakte hain, lekin legal risk ke saath sasta mehnga par jata hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039788.next: Dekhna hoga ke SNGPL supply behtar karta hai ya rally waqai dharne tak jati hai — aur LPG prices agle hafte neeche aati hain ya yehi manmani jari rehti hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039788.take: Meri take: gas nahi, aata mehnga, petrol upar — aur beech mein awam. Rally nikalna aasan hai, supply theek karna mushkil. Lekin ek baat sahi hai: jab shortage 'masnooi' ho to ye management failure nahi, chor-bazaari hai. Aur chor-bazaari pe sirf bayan nahi, giraftari chahiye. Warna har sardiyon mein yehi drama dobara hoga.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039788.what: PPP ne Lahore mein Sunday ko LPG shortage aur barhti aata aur fuel qeematon ke khilaaf protest rally nikali — aur warning di ke agar gas outages jari rahi to Sui Northern Gas Pipelines ke head office ke bahar dharna diya jayega. Lahore president Faisal Mir ne kaha ke masnooi shortage bana kar awam ko loota ja raha hai, aur chhote dukandaron ki jagah bare zakhira andozon pe action hona chahiye.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039788.why: LPG ki kami sirf ek fuel ki khabar nahi — ye sardiyon se pehle kitchen ka masla hai. Jab gas nahi aati to har ghar ka budget hilta hai, aur jab qeemat manmani ho to sab se zyada ghareeb marta hai. Opposition ki rally is liye important hai kyunki ye masla ab street pe aa gaya hai, sirf press release mein nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039798.next: Royalty law ka draft agle meeting mein aayega — us ki wording batayegi ke ye asli protection hai ya sirf naam. Aur Film City ki 15 December ki date pe waqai iftitah hota hai ya ye bhi delay list mein shamil ho jata hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039798.take: Meri take: pehli baar kisi ne film walon ke liye sirf tareef nahi, qanoon aur paisay ki baat ki hai — ye achi shuruat hai. Lekin suno, Film City ki building se film nahi banti, achi kahani se banti hai. Rebate lo, royalty lo, lekin script pe mehnat karo — warna bari building mein bhi chhoti filmein banengi. Lahore ka cinema wapas aana chahiye, aur ye us taraf ek qadam hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039798.what: Punjab CM Maryam Nawaz ne mulk ka pehla film royalty law banane ki hidayat di hai — Punjab mein banne wali Punjabi films pe 35% aur Urdu films pe 20% rebate milega. Lahore mein 15 December ko Film City ka iftitah hoga — film school, museum, studios aur Pakistan ka sab se bara convention centre is mein hoga. Film City Authority ka Rs589 million se zyada ka budget bhi review ke liye bheja gaya hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039798.why: Pakistani film industry saalon se sirf shikayat karti aayi hai: paisa nahi, system nahi, izzat nahi. Royalty law pehli baar creators ko un ke kaam ka hissa legally dene ki taraf qadam hai — aur rebate ka matlab hai ke film banana ab thora sasta parega. Agar ye sirf announcement nahi, implementation hai to Lollywood ki wapsi ka chance hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039815/pakist.next: 11 Technical Working Groups ko operational karna hi asli test hai — meetings se aage barh kar kya Qatari investment waqai agriculture, cold storage aur IT mein aati hai? Aur bone-in meat exports pe lagi restrictions hat-ti hain ya nahi?
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039815/pakist.take: Meri take: har mulk ke saath task force, har task force ke saath working groups — paperwork to poora hai, bas paisa aana baki hai. Qatar ko motorway offer karna samajh aata hai, lekin yaad rakho: investor pehle apna faida dekhta hai, dosti baad mein. Agar deal mein Pakistan ke farmers aur workers ka hissa pakka hai to ye achi khabar hai, warna sirf ek aur photo-op.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039815/pakist.what: Pakistan aur Qatar ne Doha mein apni Joint Task Force on Trade and Investment ki doosri meeting ki — Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan aur Qatar ke Minister of State for Foreign Trade Affairs ne chair ki. Agriculture, food security, manufacturing, IT, maritime transport aur infrastructure pe baat hui, saath hi Pakistan-GCC free trade agreement jaldi sign karne pe zor diya gaya. Karachi-Hyderabad Motorway bhi Qatar ko investment ke liye offer ki gayi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039815/pakist.why: Qatar ke paas paisa hai, Pakistan ke paas agriculture, location aur workforce hai — ye combination agar sahi jure to dono ko faida hai. GCC free trade agreement is liye bara hai kyunki wo sirf Qatar tak mehdood nahi, poori Gulf market ka darwaza kholta hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039821/dar-ch.next: Xinjiang se aayi 22-member business delegation ke baad dekhna hoga ke joint ventures waqai sign hote hain ya sirf visits hoti hain. Industrial zones mein factory lagna hi asli progress hogi, meeting ki photo nahi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039821/dar-ch.take: Meri take: CPEC phase two ki baat sun ke umeed bhi hai aur thakaan bhi — umeed is liye ke factories aur technology ki baat ho rahi hai, thakaan is liye ke hum ye baatein saalon se sun rahe hain. Mulaqat achi hai, lekin mulaqat se factory nahi lagti. Jab koi Chinese-Pakistani joint venture waqai production shuru kare to us din mubarakbad banti hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039821/dar-ch.what: Deputy PM Ishaq Dar ne Chinese Ambassador Jiang Zaidong se Sunday ko Islamabad mein mulaqat ki aur CPEC ki progress ka jaiza liya — trade, investment, regional connectivity, agricultural modernisation aur people-to-people exchanges pe baat hui. Ab CPEC ka doosra phase industrialisation, technology aur export-led growth pe focus kar raha hai; pehle phase mein taqreeban $25 billion Chinese investment aayi thi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039821/dar-ch.why: CPEC ki har mulaqat is liye news hai kyunki is project se Pakistan ki economy ki direction tay hoti hai — ab sirf roads aur bijli nahi, factories aur exports ki baat ho rahi hai. Doosra phase agar sahi chala to jobs aur exports dono barh sakte hain; agar sirf meetings tak raha to phir wohi purani kahani.

https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactio.next: Ab nazar OpenAI ki valuation aur revenue pe hogi — kya ye investment kabhi wapas aayega? Aur SoftBank ke baqi bets pe is ka kya asar parega, kyunki itna bara cheque likhne ke baad cash kam reh jata hai.
https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactio.take: Meri take: $64.6 billion — ye number parh ke aam developer ko sirf ek baat samajh aani chahiye: AI ki race mein paisa ab barrier hai, idea nahi. Lekin is ka matlab ye nahi ke chhote players ka khel khatam — bari companies infrastructure banati hain, chhoti companies us infrastructure pe asli products banati hain. Aap ko OpenAI nahi banna, us ke upar kuch useful banana hai.
https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactio.what: SoftBank ne OpenAI mein apni $30 billion investment ka aakhri phase mukammal kar liya — teen $10 billion tranches ke zariye Vision Fund 2 se. Ab SoftBank ki OpenAI mein total investment $64.6 billion hai, jo 13% stake banti hai.
https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactio.why: Ye number batata hai ke AI race ab startup funding nahi, country-level paisay ki game hai. $64.6 billion ek company mein lagana ye kehta hai ke SoftBank ka poora future OpenAI ki kamyabi se jura hua hai. Is scale pe koi 'diversified bet' nahi hoti — ye all-in hai.

https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/s.next: Final 31 October ko isi Gaddafi Stadium mein hai — ab sawal ye hai ke kya ye jeet team ko final mein bhi wahi jazba degi, ya celebration mein hi energy khatam ho jayegi. Shadab ki form final ka sab se bara asset hai.
https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/s.take: Meri take: 154-9 se 242 chase — ye woh match hai jo bachon ko 20 saal baad sunaya jayega. Shadab ne sirf runs nahi banaye, us ne poori team ki haar ko jeet mein badal diya. Aur Rauf ka 19 balls pe 7 runs — scorecard pe chhota lagta hai, lekin wahi 7 runs final ki ticket thi. Ab bas final mein yehi himmat chahiye — aur overconfidence nahi.
https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/s.what: Shadab Khan ne naqabil-e-shikast 113 runs banaye aur Haris Rauf ke saath aakhri wicket pe record 89-run partnership ki — Pakistan 154-9 se wapas aaya aur Lahore mein England ko 1 wicket se hara kar tri-series final mein pahunch gaya. England 241 pe all out hui, Ben Duckett ke 105 ke bawajood; Shaheen ne 4-46 liye. Pakistan ne 17 balls pehle target chase kar liya.
https://www.reuters.com/sports/cricket/s.why: 154-9 se jeetna sirf scorecard nahi, team ka character hai. Jab Fakhar aur Babar 10-10 pe out ho gaye to match khatam lag raha tha — lekin Shadab ne 13 fours aur 5 sixes ke saath match palat diya. Aakhri wicket ki ye partnership successful ODI chase mein sab se bari hai — ye record aise hi nahi banta.

https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-indust.next: Jo sites abhi tak patch nahi hui, wo sab se zyada khatre mein hain — kyunki AI se exploit banane ka waqt bhi kam ho gaya hai. Agar aap ki site PHP pe hai to version check karna aaj ka kaam hai, kal ka nahi.
https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-indust.take: Meri take: AI ne bug dhoondha, AI ne exploit bhi banane mein madad ki — ye dono taraf ki talwar hai. Achi khabar ye hai ke defenders ko bhi wohi hathiyar mil gaya hai. Buri khabar ye hai ke jo admin 'kal update kar dunga' kehta hai, us ke paas ab kal nahi hai. Patch karo, phir tweet karo.
https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-indust.what: OpenAI ke GPT-5.6 Sol ne Patch the Planet initiative ke tahat PHP ke do critical flaws dhoondhne mein madad ki — PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 aur CVE-2026-109619), jin se bina login ke server pe code chalaya ja sakta tha. PHP ne 21 October ko fixes release kiye (8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35). Wiz ne bhi dono flaws independently dhoondhe.
https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-indust.why: PHP taqreeban 70% websites chalata hai — WordPress se le kar bari sites tak. Is liye ye sirf ek bug ki khabar nahi, poore internet ki khabar hai. Aur is ka doosra pehlu ye hai ke AI ab sirf code likhne ka tool nahi raha, wo internet-scale vulnerabilities bhi dhoondh raha hai — jo do saal se insaanon se chhooti hui thin.

https://www.unite.ai/openai-releases-722.next: Asal test ye hai ke kitne results independent checking mein tikte hain — teen manuscripts to pehle hi wapas liye ja chuke hain. Agar aksar results sahi nikle to ye math ki history ka turning point hai; agar ghaltiyan zyada niklin to ye sirf ek bara press release reh jayega.
https://www.unite.ai/openai-releases-722.take: Meri take: 722 papers ek saath — ye research nahi, flood hai. Lekin flood ko ignore bhi nahi kar sakte: agar machine itne problems solve kar sakti hai to humari parhai ka matlab badal jayega. Students ke liye lesson ye nahi ke math chhor do — lesson ye hai ke ab math seekhna = problems solve karna nahi, problems samajhna aur verify karna hai. Wo skill machine se nahi chheeni ja sakti.
https://www.unite.ai/openai-releases-722.what: OpenAI ne ek unreleased internal frontier model se banaye 722 manuscripts public GitHub repository mein daal diye — 372 result families mein. Model ko taqreeban 4,000 problems diye gaye the, aur har result pe taqreeban 3 ghante ChatGPT Pro thinking compute lagi. Kai results ke Lean proofs bhi hain, lekin sab ke nahi — aur OpenAI khud kehta hai ke kuch unformalised results mein ghalti ho sakti hai.
https://www.unite.ai/openai-releases-722.why: Ye AI ki capability ka sab se seedha saboot hai: math ke open problems jo insaan saalon mein solve karte hain, wo model ne bulk mein nikaal diye. Lekin mathematicians ki narazgi bhi samajh aati hai — 722 papers ek saath phenkna scholarship nahi, power show lagta hai. Verification ka bojh ab poori community pe hai.
